Name: Common Sensor Attitude Data DES
Description: The Common Sensor Attitude data (CSATTB) DES provides chronologically-ordered sensor attitude information needed to run the rigorous sensor model that performs geolocation and mensuration. Quaternion data provided in this DES are used to construct an orthogonal rotation matrix that transforms a line-of-sight vector from the sensor frame to the object (ECF or ECI) frame. This DES is used in conjunction with the other GLAS/GFM SDEs.

DE.Name: File Part Type
DE.Description: This field shall contain the characters DE.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: This field shall contain the alphanumeric version number of the use of the tag. The version number is assigned as part of the registration process.

DESCLAS.Name: Data Extension File Security Classification
DESCLAS.Description: This field shall contain a valid value representing the classification level of the DES. Valid values are T for Top Secret, S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted, or U for Unclassified.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-Defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field contains the number of bytes in the user-defined subheader.

UUID.Name: Assigned UUID for the DES
UUID.Description: This UUID refers to the entire DES, i.e., bith the subheader and the data portions of the DES.

NUMAIS.Name: Number of Associated Image Segments
NUMAIS.Description: This field provides the number of image segments associated with this DES. If NUMAIS = ALL, the DES is associated with all image segments in the NITF dataset, and field AISDLVLn is omitted. Otherwise, NUMAIS is between 1 and 998 (999 is covered by ALL) and is no more than the number of image segments in the dataset.

AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Name: Nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Description: This field provides the Image Display Level (IDLVL) of each image segment associated with this DES. AISDLVLn shall correspond to IDLVL values of image segments in the same dataset. If NUMAIS = ALL, this field is omitted.

NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Name: Number of Associated Elements
NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Description: This field contains the number of elements associated with this DES. For Level 1 and 2 conformance, this list shall include the IMAGE_UUID from the CSEXRB TRE for all images associated with this DES, as well as the UUIDs of any other elements that are authoritatively associated with this DES.

ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Name: UUID of the nth Associated Element
ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Description: This field contains the UUID of the nth element associated with the DES. The type of associated element is unrestricted.

RESERVEDSUBH.Name: Reserved Subheader Field
RESERVEDSUBH.Description: This field is reserved for future use.

QUAL_FLAG_ATT.Name: Attitude Data Quality Flag
QUAL_FLAG_ATT.Description: This field indicates the quality of the provided attitude data.

INTERP_TYPE_ATT.Name: Interpolation Type
INTERP_TYPE_ATT.Description: This field identifies the type of interpolation recommended for the end user.

INTERP_ORDER_ATT.Name: Order of Interpolation Plynomial
INTERP_ORDER_ATT.Description: This field indicates the order of the interpolation polynomials recommended for the end user. If INTERP_TYPE_ATT = 2, then INTERP_ORDER_ATT may be 3, 5, or 7 and is the Lagrangian polynomial order. If INTERP_TYPE_ATT =3, then INTERP_ORDER_ATT may be 1 or 3, with 1 indicating spherical linear interpolation, and 3 indicating spherical spline interpolation.

ATT_TYPE.Name: Attitude Type
ATT_TYPE.Description: This field identifies the type of attitude data supplied in the DES. Refined attitude data (ATT_TYPE = 2) indicates smoothed attitude data resulting from data processing.

ECI_ECF_ATT.Name: Coordinate Reference Frame Flag
ECI_ECF_ATT.Description: This field identifies whether attitude data are with respect to Earth-Centered Fixed (ECF) or Earth-Centered Inertial (ECI) reference frames.

TA_POLE.Name: TA Pole
TA_POLE.Description: This field provides the time (Julian date) associated with the polar wander parameters.

A_POLE.Name: A Pole
A_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter A in arc-seconds.

B_POLE.Name: B Pole
B_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter B in arc-seconds/day.

CJ1_POLE.Name: C Pole
CJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter CJ1 in arc-seconds.

CJ2_POLE.Name: C Pole
CJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter CJ2 in arc-seconds.

DJ1_POLE.Name: D Pole
DJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter DJ1 in arc-seconds.

DJ2_POLE.Name: D Pole
DJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter DJ2 in arc-seconds.

PJ1_POLE.Name: PJ Pole
PJ1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter PJ1 (Julian days)associated with the polar wanter parameters.

PJ2_POLE.Name: PJ Pole
PJ2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter PJ2 (Julian days)associated with the polar wanter parameters.

E_POLE.Name: E Pole
E_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter E in arc-seconds.

F_POLE.Name: E Pole
F_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter F in arc-seconds/day.

GK1_POLE.Name: GK Pole
GK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter GK1 in arc-seconds.

GK2_POLE.Name: GK Pole
GK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter GK2 in arc-seconds.

HK1_POLE.Name: HK Pole
HK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter HK1 in arc-seconds.

HK2_POLE.Name: HK Pole
HK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the polar wander parameter HK2 in arc-seconds.

PK1_POLE.Name: PK Pole
PK1_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PK1 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

PK2_POLE.Name: PK Pole
PK2_POLE.Description: This field provides the period PK2 (Julian days) associated with the polar wander parameters.

TB_UT.Name: TB_UT - Julian Date
TB_UT.Description: This field provides the time (Julian date) associated with the universal time (UT) parameters.

I_UT.Name: UT - Seconds
I_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter in seconds.

J_UT.Name: UT - Seconds
J_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter in seconds.

KN1_UT.Name: UT K1 - Seconds
KN1_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter K1 in seconds.

KN2_UT.Name: UT K2 - Seconds
KN2_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter K2 in seconds.

KN3_UT.Name: UT K3 - Seconds
KN3_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter K3 in seconds.

KN4_UT.Name: UT K4 - Seconds
KN4_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter K4 in seconds.

LN1_UT.Name: UT L1 - Seconds
LN1_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter L1 in seconds.

LN2_UT.Name: UT L2 - Seconds
LN2_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter L2 in seconds.

LN3_UT.Name: UT L3 - Seconds
LN3_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter L3 in seconds.

LN4_UT.Name: UT L4 - Seconds
LN4_UT.Description: This field provides the UT parameter L4 in seconds.

PN1_UT.Name: PN1 - Julian Days
PN1_UT.Description: This field provides the period PN1 (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN2_UT.Name: PN2 - Julian Days
PN2_UT.Description: This field provides the period PN2 (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN3_UT.Name: PN3 - Julian Days
PN3_UT.Description: This field provides the period PN3 (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

PN4_UT.Name: PN4 - Julian Days
PN4_UT.Description: This field provides the period PN4 (Julian days) associated with the UT parameters.

DT_ATT.Name: Time Between Attitude Reference Points
DT_ATT.Description: This field contains the time interval between chronologically ordered consecutive attitude reference points.

DATE_ATT.Name: Date of First Attitude Reference Point
DATE_ATT.Description: This field contains the date of the first attitude reference point formatted as CCYYMMDD.

TO_ATT.Name: Time Stamp of First Attitude Reference Point
TO_ATT.Description: This field contains the time stamp of the first attitude reference point formatted as hhmmss.nnnnnnnnn.

NUM_ATT.Name: Number of Attitude Reference Points
NUM_ATT.Description: This field contains the number of attitude reference points throughout the scan interval.

Q1<NUM_ATT>.Name: Quaternion 1 of the nth Attitude Reference Point
Q1<NUM_ATT>.Description: This field contains the attitude quaternion components Q1, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_ATT, for the nth attitude reference point, listed in chronological order. Angular offsets from the CSSFAB DES need to be applied to the Qn values to generate sensor frame attitude. If angular offsets are zero, then these quaternions define the sensor frame attitude.

Q2<NUM_ATT>.Name: Quaternion 2 of the nth Attitude Reference Point
Q2<NUM_ATT>.Description: This field contains the attitude quaternion components Q2, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_ATT, for the nth attitude reference point, listed in chronological order. Angular offsets from the CSSFAB DES need to be applied to the Qn values to generate sensor frame attitude. If angular offsets are zero, then these quaternions define the sensor frame attitude.

Q3<NUM_ATT>.Name: Quaternion 3 of the nth Attitude Reference Point
Q3<NUM_ATT>.Description: This field contains the attitude quaternion components Q3, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_ATT, for the nth attitude reference point, listed in chronological order. Angular offsets from the CSSFAB DES need to be applied to the Qn values to generate sensor frame attitude. If angular offsets are zero, then these quaternions define the sensor frame attitude.

Q4<NUM_ATT>.Name: Quaternion 4 of the nth Attitude Reference Point
Q4<NUM_ATT>.Description: This field contains the attitude quaternion components Q4, in either the ECI or ECF reference frame, depending upon the value of ECI_ECF_ATT, for the nth attitude reference point, listed in chronological order. Angular offsets from the CSSFAB DES need to be applied to the Qn values to generate sensor frame attitude. If angular offsets are zero, then these quaternions define the sensor frame attitude.

RESERVED_LEN.Name: Length of the Reserved Field
RESERVED_LEN.Description: This field shall be shown as 000000000.
